review.scope: Bounded SQL, age provenance/date precision, fixed-version continuation, actual-read citation ranges, semantic edition approval, source fetching and PDF worker bounds, source attribution and contracts

offline.evidence: Agent tool output, not retained stdout
offline.limitations: Original fixture type diagnostics and one reduced-capacity continuation failure preserved as executor report; no fabricated historical stdout.

pdf.synthetic: One aggregate with file-bound continuation and page-number-only rejection passed
pdf.failures: Original Windows resource URL and Node24.11 standard-build toHex compatibility failures retained; fixed using official legacy build.

originalBatch.stop: During bounded context group; original diagnostic was generic and cause remains undetermined.

retainedFixtureReadOnly.meaning: Same fixture search and context succeeded, once with original pool configuration; does not relabel original failure.

remainingBatch.scope: Only previously unexecuted semantic publication groups; original fixture reused; no repeated capacity group.

sql.cleanup: Exact fixture IDs removed; original FHS sources and family counts retained; worker false.

verification.typecheck: Executor scoped strict 12 roots: 0 diagnostics; not whole-repo
verification.seed: 5 sources/6 chunks parse with actual schema

notRun: new seed publication in local or production database
gate: Primary accepts minimal package functional evidence; original unreproduced SQL batch failure retained as limitation for A09 representative deployment flow.
